item.name: 06 Stored run matches what was returned

exec: pm.test('same question and dataset', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.include({question: 'How many orders were canceled?', dataset: 'olist'}); });

item.name: 07 Query audit trail for the run

exec: pm.test('each query has SQL and a row count or an error', () => { pm.response.json().forEach(q => { pm.expect(q.sql_submitted).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(q.row_count !== null || q.error !== null).to.be.true; }); });

exec: pm.test("newest entry is this run's feedback", () => { pm.expect(log[0]).to.include({event: 'feedback', run_id: pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')}); });
pm.test('previous entry is this run being recorded', () => { pm.expect(log[1].event).to.eql('run_recorded'); });
